help.text:
This tool runs the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark (https://www.cisecurity.org/benchmark/kubernetes/)

Usage:
  kube-bench [flags]
  kube-bench [command]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command
  run         Run tests
  version     Shows the version of kube-bench.

Flags:
      --alsologtostderr                   log to standard error as well as files
      --asff                              Send the results to AWS Security Hub
      --benchmark string                  Manually specify CIS benchmark version. It would be an error to specify both --version and --benchmark flags
  -c, --check string                      A comma-delimited list of checks to run as specified in CIS document. Example --check="1.1.1,1.1.2"
      --config string                     config file (default is ./cfg/config.yaml)
  -D, --config-dir string                 config directory (default "./cfg/")
      --exit-code int                     Specify the exit code for when checks fail
  -g, --group string                      Run all the checks under this comma-delimited list of groups. Example --group="1.1"
  -h, --help                              help for kube-bench
      --include-test-output               Prints the actual result when test fails
      --json                              Prints the results as JSON
      --junit                             Prints the results as JUnit
      --log_backtrace_at traceLocations   when logging hits line file:N, emit a stack trace
      --log_dir string                    If non-empty, write log files in this directory
      --log_link string                   If non-empty, add symbolic links in this directory to the log files
      --logbuflevel int                   Buffer log messages logged at this level or lower (-1 means don't buffer; 0 means buffer INFO only; ...). Has limited applicability on non-prod platforms.
      --logtostderr                       log to standard error instead of files (default true)
      --noremediations                    Disable printing of remediations section
      --noresults                         Disable printing of results section
      --nosummary                         Disable printing of summary section
      --nototals                          Disable printing of totals for failed, passed, ... checks across all sections
      --outputfile string                 Writes the results to output file when run with --json or --junit
      --pgsql                             Save the results to PostgreSQL
      --scored                            Run the scored CIS checks (default true)
      --skip string                       List of comma separated values of checks to be skipped
      --stderrthreshold severityFlag      logs at or above this threshold go to stderr (default 2)
      --unscored                          Run the unscored CIS checks (default true)
  -v, --v Level                           log level for V logs
      --version string                    Manually specify Kubernetes version, automatically detected if unset
      --vmodule vModuleFlag               comma-separated list of pattern=N settings for file-filtered logging

Use "kube-bench [command] --help" for more information about a command.

--alsologtostderr.help: log to standard error as well as files

--asff.help: Send the results to AWS Security Hub

--benchmark.help: Manually specify CIS benchmark version. It would be an error to specify both --version and --benchmark flags

--check.help: A comma-delimited list of checks to run as specified in CIS document. Example --check="1.1.1,1.1.2"

--exit-code.help: Specify the exit code for when checks fail

--file.help: Alternative YAML file for federated checks

--group.help: Run all the checks under this comma-delimited list of groups. Example --group="1.1"

--include-test-output.help: Prints the actual result when test fails

--log_backtrace_at.help: when logging hits line file:N, emit a stack trace

--log_dir.help: If non-empty, write log files in this directory

--log_link.help: If non-empty, add symbolic links in this directory to the log files

--logbuflevel.help: Buffer log messages logged at this level or lower (-1 means don't buffer; 0 means buffer INFO only; ...). Has limited applicability on non-prod platforms.

--logtostderr.help: log to standard error instead of files (default true)

--nototals.help: Disable printing of totals for failed, passed, ... checks across all sections

--outputfile.help: Writes the results to output file when run with --json or --junit

--scored.help: Run the scored CIS checks (default true)

--skip.help: List of comma separated values of checks to be skipped

--stderrthreshold.help: logs at or above this threshold go to stderr (default 2)

--unscored.help: Run the unscored CIS checks (default true)

--version.help: Manually specify Kubernetes version, automatically detected if unset

--vmodule.help: comma-separated list of pattern=N settings for file-filtered logging

federated.help: Run benchmark checks for a Kubernetes federated deployment.

master.help: Run benchmark checks for a Kubernetes master node.

node.help: Run benchmark checks for a Kubernetes node.

--file.--exit-code: Specify the exit code for when checks fail
--file.--group: Run all the checks under this comma-delimited list of groups. Example --group="1.1"
--file.--include-test-output: Prints the actual result when test fails
--file.--log_backtrace_at: when logging hits line file:N, emit a stack trace
--file.--log_dir: If non-empty, write log files in this directory
--file.--log_link: If non-empty, add symbolic links in this directory to the log files
--file.--logbuflevel: Buffer log messages logged at this level or lower (-1 means don't buffer; 0 means buffer INFO only; ...). Has limited applicability on non-prod platforms.
--file.--logtostderr: log to standard error instead of files (default true)
--file.--nototals: Disable printing of totals for failed, passed, ... checks across all sections
--file.--outputfile: Writes the results to output file when run with --json or --junit
--file.--scored: Run the scored CIS checks (default true)
--file.--skip: List of comma separated values of checks to be skipped
--file.--stderrthreshold: logs at or above this threshold go to stderr (default 2)
--file.--unscored: Run the unscored CIS checks (default true)
--file.--version: Manually specify Kubernetes version, automatically detected if unset
--file.--vmodule: comma-separated list of pattern=N settings for file-filtered logging
